case: A1 core rev R of 2026-11-13 (parametric rebuild, ring beam, 18.12 g), tray T800, 1.0 mm stack
model: voxel hex8 h 0.6 mm, PETG E 2000 MPa; motors 4 x 4.0 g on the holders, stack + cover 15.0 g on the 4 bosses, battery on the tray lips and rails (latch tongue excluded), flow board 1.5 g on its bosses; free-free
first_mode: tray rear overhang with the battery (tray-local)
tray_joint: tray screwed to the 4 lugs: modelled as bonded on Ø5.2 pads at the lug faces (z -9.0); before rev R the bond came from voxel contact only
note_rev_R: The section 13 core had knee braces 0.6 mm from the tray rails: at h 0.6 mm the voxel model joined them, so the tray rear was held by the core and its first modes (84.9 / 90.3 Hz) were optimistic. Rev R leaves 1.36 mm there: the tray rear end with the battery is free, as in the real part. The model carries the battery as mass only (no pack stiffness), so the tray-local modes are a lower bound: check them with a tap test.
